title: ====Apple (AAPL) cuts its revenue guidance for the first time since 2002
text: Wednesday, January 2, 2019 ====Apple (AAPL) cuts its revenue guidance for the first time since 2002 Specifically, Apple lowered its Q1 fiscal revenue guidance to $84 billion from the previously forecast range of $89-$93 billion. CEO Tim Cook, in a CNBC interview, said the shortfall is solely due to weaker-than-expected iPhone revenue, primarily in Greater China. Mr. Cook added that he believes trade tensions between the United States and China have put additional pressure on China's economy. Posted by Eva S at 5:00 PM
